speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe exactly when your gait and limb ataxia started and whether the symptoms have been getting worse gradually or suddenly?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: I see. Since you mentioned the clumsiness is especially on the right side, has this onset been sudden, like something happening all at once, or has it developed slowly over weeks or months?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that crucial information. Given your history of Crohn's disease and current use of natalizumab, I am concerned about the possibility of Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).
